{{Top}}
[[File:MeditationBracelet-TNR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Force-sensitive wearing a meditation bracelet]]
A '''bracelet''' was a decorative item worn by individuals. Members of the [[Jiivahar]] and [[Rakririan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wore ornate bracelets.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Some [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] wore a [[Meditation bracelet|bracelet]] as a focal point for [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]].

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] wore a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] bracelet as a gift from her [[Ven Zallow|Master]] for her reaching knighthood.
